name: What should I do first if I want a kitchen island installed?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want a kitchen island installed?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Start by deciding whether the island is mainly for prep, seating, storage, cooking, or cleanup. Elite Remodeling & Design can evaluate the existing kitchen, develop layout options, and coordinate design, construction, and any needed permit work as one remodeling plan.

Context: An island affects circulation, cabinet placement, lighting, flooring, and sometimes plumbing or electrical systems. A design that looks attractive on paper can feel cramped once appliance doors, drawers, and stools are in use.

Key factors:
- Measure the room, door swings, windows, ceiling height, and appliance locations.
- Identify whether the island needs seating, a sink, dishwasher, cooktop, outlets, or lighting.
- Check floor condition before deciding on a fixed cabinet footprint.

Practical guidance: Bring photos, rough measurements, and a list of daily frustrations to the consultation. Ask for a scaled layout or 3D visualization before ordering cabinets or stone.

Elite Remodeling & Design’s design-build process is suited to projects where layout decisions and construction details need to be coordinated.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, define how the island will be used and measure the room, appliance clearances, door swings, and available walkways. Elite Remodeling & Design can then develop layout options and identify whether the project affects flooring, electrical, plumbing, lighting, or permits before construction begins.
